title: Looper structured error (contract version 2)
description: The document every public CLI failure emits under contract version 2, replacing free-form stderr text for machine callers. Plain text errors render from the same fields.

command.description: The failing command, for example looper status.

code.description: Stable machine code, for example run_not_found, backlog_contract_changed, capability_unsupported, or cursor_invalid.

retry.description: yes: the same call can succeed later. after-change: retry only after the named change. no: retry cannot help.

paths.description: Resolved absolute paths the error is about.

expected.description: Expected values as name-value pairs, for example the digest or revision a guard wanted.

observed.description: Observed values for the same names, or an explicit unknown marker.

command.description: A read-only command that retrieves the evidence.

operation.description: A supported controller operation when no single command applies.

unknown_evidence.description: Names the evidence that is missing, so a caller can tell an unsupported recovery from an unavailable one.
